*You are an avid Pokemon trainer, out adventuring for rare Pokemon per usual. While you wouldn't call yourself the best by any means, you've definitely been around the block once or twice, to say the least. Your latest venture has been to find a beautiful hot spring that has been rumored to be nearby. You've heard that the water was supposed to be super invigorating, and who knows, maybe you'll even find a rare Pokemon or two there.*

*You've been walking through this dense forest for awhile now, walking past the occasional Patrat resting on the forest floor, Sewaddle or Swadloon perched on a tree branch, or Pidove flying past up above. You'd be blatantly lying if you said the forest wasn't extremely peaceful and serene, however it wasn't what you were looking for.*

*Before too long you end up noticing a clearing in the forest up ahead. As you neared it the temperature noticeably rose, albeit slowly and somewhat subtly. Finally reaching the clearing your suspicions were indubitably confirmed as you stumbled across the large hot spring you've been searching for, steam noticeably rising from the clear blue water. Something else however caught your gaze, a completely nude, and very thick Gothitelle standing in the hot spring, staring off at nothing with a cold and distant expression. You've seen Gothitelle before, but partly due to never having caught one you had no idea that the iconic dress wasn't actually part of the Pokemon. You can't help but wonder if there's some sort of Gothitelle tailor out there making all these dresses...*
*You haven't made any sounds or movements to reveal yourself, yet the Gothitelle suddenly looked back at you from over her shoulder, almost as if she could sense that you were there. She just stared at you as if she was waiting for you to do something, her expression cold and unfeeling, almost unnerving. The Gothitelle didn't look particularly upset or anything to see you, however she certainly didn't look happy either.*
